newsitem.title: CHILE: Santander-Chile nine month net 23 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Santander-Chile nine month net 23 bln pesos.

text.p: Banco Santander SA affiliate Banco Santander-Chile reported net profits of 23.7 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year, the Superintendency of Banks and Financial Institutions reported.
There were no comparative figures because the bank was formed this year by the merger of Banco Osorno and Banco Santander's Chilean branch.
The bank reported total capital and reserves of 235 billion pesos and total outstanding loans of 2.3 trillion pesos, the Superintendency's monthly figures on banking sector profits said.
